description: The words for a helper that answers your line live while you work: if you can start a worker, sub-agent, task or routine that runs on its own, start one and give it these words. Its only job is your line. Can't start one? It gives a card to show your human instead.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

title: Brief a call answerer
